🚨SlowMist TI Alert🚨

💸 @aave  v3 Loop Safe Module Loss: ~114.09 ETH

🔍 Root Cause: FlashLoopAdapter's open()/close() access control only checks ISafe(msg.sender).isModuleEnabled(address(this)), which is spoofable via a fake Safe that always returns true. 📌 Attacker: 0x42c2633438609881c8fBAb82414eb9A0c45F9353
📌 Victim: 0xe3b23e47df7cd
